engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Left/Right-Hand Traffic Switchover (Tourist Solution) Setting
technicalNotes:
This Fault Code is only set with Tourist Solution active, as soon as the Tourist Solution Setting is being deactivated the Fault Code will clear (automatically).
Most Headlight Levelling Kontrol Modülüs have an Adaptasyon / Kalibrasyon:  Channel for this Setting. Depending on the Vehicle Options/Equipment, you may also find a Driver accessible Setting in either the Gösterge Paneli or Radio/Multimedia/Infotainment System Car Menu/Options.
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: Audi A3/S3 (8P): Headlight Aim Control (Xenon Plus), Kontrol edin: Tourist Solution Setting.
